name: Juujou Mito
source:
Mito is a colonel of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and a member of Guren's squad in the Moon Demon Company. She is also the daughter of the prestigious Juujou family.

Mito is the classic tsundere Ojou-sama. She is well-bred, gets riled up easily, and is attentive to etiquette and station. She is also quite stubborn. Despite being part of Guren's personal squad, she refuses to recognize his leadership. Due to the prestige of the house, since she was young, Mito had never been treated by the people around her like a normal girl, until she met Guren. While Guren frequently frustrated her with his snide comments and jokes, she developed an unrequited crush on him due to the refreshing treatment.

[From [url=http://owarinoseraph.wikia.com/wiki/Mito_Jūjō]Owari no Seraph Wiki[/url]]
